relations.note: a title read, and not a house visited

story.body: You read the title and left the bill on its peg. The afternoon in front of you was your own.

relations.note: a title read, and not a house visited

participation.context: Spoke the prologue, steady, and did not count the house.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Was already in the part, a pace off the opening.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

relations.note: the second afternoon, and the note kept

story.body: You began the lovers again with the same line, in a yard you did not number. You left the book as it stood, and you left the boxes alone.

relations.note: the second afternoon, and the note kept
